maya: CI started failing on eval-tool-adapter after the new quantized model onboarding. stack trace in the job, any clues?
ci-bot: job #4821 failed - tests/evals/test_tool_adapter.py::test_metadata_handling - see logs https://ci.redwood.ai/4821 (failure at 1742504360)
sam: reproduced locally with master + quantized runtime. failing because runner does `meta.get('version')` and `meta` is a list, not a dict.
jordan: ugh, that shape came from the model's tool output: `"metadata": [{"version": "1.2", "tags": ["v1"]}]` instead of `{"version":"1.2"}`. older models returned object.
eva: attached minimal repro JSON: ```json
{
  "tool_output": {
    "name": "analyze",
    "result": "ok",
    "metadata": [{"version":"1.2","source":"external"}]
  }
}
```
sam: stack snippet from runner: ```
File "/srv/runner/eval_adapter.py", line 214, in parse_tool_output
    v = meta.get('version')
TypeError: list object has no attribute 'get'
```
jordan: quick fix is to normalize singleton arrays: `if isinstance(meta, list): meta = meta[0] if len(meta)==1 else raise` — but that could silently hide real regressions where model returns multiple metadata entries.
eva: yeah we shouldn't make the validator too permissive. propose: update JSONSchema for tool_output.metadata to `oneOf: [ {type: object}, {type: array, items: {type: object}} ]` and change runner to normalize array->object for len==1 but *also* add an eval assertion that fails when len>1 so CI flags it.
maya: sounds good, add tests for both shapes and a failing case for len>1. Sam can you own the runner patch?
sam: will do. local patch here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/eval-harness/pull/1234 - it implements normalizer + new tests. run `pytest tests/evals/test_tool_adapter.py::test_metadata_handling -q` to verify.
jordan: also add a migration note in the evals CHANGELOG and a small dashboard alert: metric `eval_tool_schema_warnings` increments when normalization is applied at runtime. we don't want silent fixes.
eva: I created the schema change proposal in the PR description. Example schema snippet: ```json
"metadata": {
  "oneOf": [
    {"type": "object"},
    {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "object"}}
  ]
}
```
ci-bot: rerun requested by @sam - job #4822 queued.
ops-bot: note: dedicated infra has the older runtime pinned in prod. if this patch is merged we need rollout plan for Dedicated vs Hosted so behavior is consistent.
maya: good catch. we'll gate the change behind a feature flag `eval_accept_metadata_array` and enable for canary. Sam add a toggle check in the runner.
sam: will add feature flag + docs in the PR. also adding a strict-test that asserts normalization only triggers for len==1.
jordan: for visibility, I'll add a short playbook step in the runbook: how to handle when models start returning arrays for fields we expect object.
eva: agreed. also adding a small eval that samples model outputs to catch shape drift earlier.
maya: thanks all. merging after CI green and we'll canary on staging. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: job #4822 passed (tests added) at 1742504689
maya: assigning follow-up issue to `jordan` to track dashboard + runbook. :white_check_mark:
